DividerSpec.description: A dashed line across a fragment, between two of its operands, as for UML's alt.

before.description: Key of the message the line goes just above.
before.title: Before

label.description: A guard such as [else], shown on the line.
label.title: Label

EdgeSpec.description: A connector between two nodes. Between two lifelines it is a message.

key.description: Your own name for this edge, unique among the page's edges, for a fragment's messages or dividers to name it.
key.title: Key

source.description: Key of the node the connector leaves.
source.title: Source

target.description: Key of the node the connector arrives at. It may be the source node when source_point and target_point name two different points of it; the connector is then routed around the shape.
target.title: Target

route.description: orthogonal: horizontal and vertical runs only. straight: one direct line. curved: one direct line with a gentle bow.
route.title: Route

source_side.description: The side the connector leaves from, at the shape's anchor on that side (its middle on most shapes). Chosen automatically when neither this nor source_point is given.
source_side.title: Source Side

target_side.description: The side the connector arrives at, at the shape's anchor on that side (its middle on most shapes). Chosen automatically when neither this nor target_point is given.
target_side.title: Target Side

source_point.description: The id of the source shape's connection point to leave from, as find_shapes.py lists it, such as a component's lead end. Instead of source_side.
source_point.title: Source Point

target_point.description: The id of the target shape's connection point to arrive at. Instead of target_side.
target_point.title: Target Point

stroke.description: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Use #00000000 for transparent; names are invalid.
stroke.title: Stroke

GridLayout.description:
Turns `col` and `row` into page coordinates.

A node's centre sits at `origin + (col * column_pitch, row * row_pitch)`.
Fractional columns and rows are allowed for staggered layouts.

origin_x.description: Page x of column 0's centre line.
origin_x.title: Origin X

origin_y.description: Page y of row 0's centre line.
origin_y.title: Origin Y

GridLayout.title: GridLayout

LaneSpec.description: One lane of a swimlanes node: its title and the nodes it holds.

members.description: Keys of the nodes in this lane. Each lies wholly inside the swimlanes, with its centre in this lane.
members.title: Members

size.description: The lane's thickness in points, only for swimlanes given a position; lanes of fitted swimlanes are fitted to their members.
size.title: Size

LaneSpec.title: LaneSpec

NodeSpec.description:
One shape on the page.

Give either `col` and `row`, or `x` and `y`. Both name the node's centre,
so nodes of different sizes still line up along shared centre lines. A
container or swimlanes may be given neither, and is then fitted around the
nodes it holds.

key.description: Your own name for this node, unique on the page.
key.title: Key

shape.description: rectangle, ellipse, note or text for a plain drawn shape; container, swimlanes, table, callout or lifeline for a shape SimpleDiagrams draws itself; or '<library>/<item>' for a library shape, for example 'basic/Cylinder'. Use a selector returned by find_shapes.py, which searches the API and falls back to assets/built-in-shapes.json offline. A packaged shape needs nothing installed; a downloadable one needs its library installed.
shape.title: Shape

scale.description: Multiplies a library shape's natural size, keeping its proportions.
scale.title: Scale

label_position.description: Use 'below' or 'above' for icons whose artwork would hide a label. A label wider than its shape is centred on it, as wide as it needs up to eight times the shape. Leave it out to use the library's own placement, such as below a BPMN event; a shape whose library says nothing puts its label in the middle.
label_position.title: Label Position

anyOf.description: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Use #00000000 for transparent; names are invalid.
#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Use #00000000 for transparent; names are invalid.
#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Use #00000000 for transparent; names are invalid.

flip_horizontal.description: Mirrors the shape's artwork left to right, as a flip in the app does. Its connection points move with the artwork and keep their ids; its label stays readable.
flip_horizontal.title: Flip Horizontal

flip_vertical.description: Mirrors the shape's artwork top to bottom, as flip_horizontal does across.
flip_vertical.title: Flip Vertical

align.description: How the label's lines are aligned, and a table's cells below its header row. A container's title starts at its leading edge unless this says otherwise; everything else is centred.
align.title: Align

hand_drawn.description: Complex shapes are drawn with gently uneven lines; false draws them exactly.
hand_drawn.title: Hand Drawn

members.description: container: keys of the nodes it holds, each lying wholly inside it. Without a position the container is fitted around them.
members.title: Members

title_style.description: container: 'band', the title across its top (the default), or 'corner_tag', a UML frame's name tag in its top-left corner.
title_style.title: Title Style

messages.description: container: keys of the messages a UML fragment (alt, loop, opt) encloses; it is fitted from the first to the last of them, across the lifelines they join.
messages.title: Messages

dividers.description: container with messages: dashed lines across it between operands, as UML's alt draws them.
dividers.title: Dividers

direction.description: swimlanes: 'horizontal' lanes run across the page as rows (the default); 'vertical' lanes run down it as columns.
direction.title: Direction

lanes.description: swimlanes: the lanes in order, top to bottom or left to right.
lanes.title: Lanes

cells.description: table: the text of each cell, row by row; every row has the same number of cells.
cells.title: Cells

header_row.description: table: whether the first row is drawn as a header (the default).
header_row.title: Header Row

column_widths.description: table: each column's width; by default each is sized to its text.
column_widths.title: Column Widths

row_heights.description: table: each row's height; by default each is sized to its text.
row_heights.title: Row Heights

tail_to.description: callout: key of the node its tail is locked to, at its connection point nearest the callout unless tail_point names one.
tail_to.title: Tail To

tail_point.description: callout: the id of tail_to's connection point to lock the tail to.
tail_point.title: Tail Point

tail_at.description: callout: the page point a free tail aims at.

head.description: lifeline: 'box', a participant's name in a box (the default), or 'actor', a stick figure with the name below it.
head.title: Head

ends_in_destroy_mark.description: lifeline: whether its line ends in UML's destroy mark, an X, just below its last message.
ends_in_destroy_mark.title: Ends In Destroy Mark

description: A whole diagram, written by an agent and compiled to a document.

anyOf.description: A UUID in 8-4-4-4-12 form. The app writes upper case; either case opens.

id.description: Document id. Omit for a new diagram; a fresh one is generated.
